cooling_description: Developer states DV4 will operate a closed-loop cooling system with water recirculating continuously; 'roughly the same amount of water as one average family home', no evaporative cooling and 'no ongoing water consumption for cooling'
notes: DataVita's submission announcement repeats the closed-loop/no-evaporative-cooling design and states a WUE target of no more than 0.05 L/kWh. This is a design target, not measured use; annual and initial-fill volumes remain undisclosed.
